name: SouthLoft Crafted Concepts
old_description: Next level hospitality deserves next level attention to detail. We thrive on working with owners, designers, and architects to help create your dream concept. We offer ready made products to fully custom pieces to fit any space.
about:
SouthLoft Crafted Concepts operates from Euless, Texas. The company traces its roots to 2014, when founder Colby Murphy began building furniture as a hobby in his father’s garage. That garage start has since grown into a full-scale production shop serving commercial and residential clients nationwide.

The shop produces custom furniture for both commercial and residential spaces. Its capabilities span design consultation, material sourcing, fabrication, finishing, and after-sale support. SouthLoft offers a line of ready-made pieces that can be customized, as well as fully bespoke builds. The operation now runs as a large-scale facility, though specific square footage and headcount are not disclosed.

The client base centers on the hospitality sector, with restaurant projects for chains such as Gloria’s Latin Cuisine, 60 Vines, Musume, and Fogo de Chão. The company also works with owners, designers, and architects on commercial interiors and private residences, exemplified by residential packages like The Bellomy Package.

SouthLoft emphasizes a quality-first mindset, describing its mission as bringing back products made with heart and soul. The founder stresses that every step — from initial consultation through material selection and final delivery — matters. The company holds its material vendors to high standards, aiming to distinguish its output from mass-produced alternatives.
